title: CLTR Cutover shared envelope definitions
description: The universal companion_envelope fields every records/*.schema.json file composes via allOf (CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 Sec.7.1), plus the shared timestamp shape. No records/*.schema.json file exists yet in this repository; this file defines the reusable shapes only. companion_envelope carries no additionalProperties:false of its own (Sec.12 of the Phase 136H implementation plan) -- the outer, file-specific schema of a future record supplies the single additionalProperties closure, re-listing every envelope field alongside its own family-local fields, so that allOf never requires unevaluatedProperties.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 / ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, explicit 'Z' suffix only (no numeric offset form), seconds required, optional 1-6 fractional digits. Validates shape only -- never freshness, expiry, monotonicity, causal order, or clock skew (Layer 4/5).

schema_version.description: This schema file's own MAJOR.MINOR version string (Sec.15). A validator implementing schema_version '1.x' must accept any '1.y' document and must reject any '2.x' document without an explicit upgrade path -- not itself enforced by this pattern, which validates shape only.

schema_id.description: Always present. Const per owning file once a records/*.schema.json file exists; identifies which record family the document is.

schema_version.description: Always present. This file's own version.

contract_version.description: Always present. Identifies which version of CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 the schema was generated against; const "1.0" at freeze time.

record_type.description: Always present. Const per owning file once a records/*.schema.json file exists; one of the 16 standalone family names (shared/enums.schema.json#/$defs/record_family).

record_digest.description: Always present. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2.

companion_envelope.description: The 7 universal envelope fields (Sec.7.1). Carries no additionalProperties restriction of its own; the future owning records/*.schema.json file supplies the single, file-level additionalProperties closure over the union of these fields and its own family-local fields.
